comparisons.name: left-end-light
comparisons.description: The left end of the shelf with its 5 pt corner, its first tile and the running dot, Aqua. Masked: the tile's icon, which is Apple artwork in the reference and a stand-in in the example, and the 5 pt of desktop picture above and beside the shelf, a photograph the example replaces with its mean colour.

comparisons.name: left-end-dark
comparisons.description: The left end of the shelf with its 5 pt corner, inner border and outer hairline, its first tile and the running dot, Dark Aqua, over 5 pt of desktop. Masked: the tile's icon, which is Apple artwork in the reference and a stand-in in the example.

comparisons.name: separator-light
comparisons.description: The separator slot between the last application and the first stack, Aqua: the shelf's top edge and the 1 by 60 pt line. The crop lies between the two icons. Masked: the 5 pt of desktop picture above the shelf, a photograph the example replaces with its mean colour.

comparisons.name: separator-dark
comparisons.description: The separator slot between the last application and the first stack, Dark Aqua: the shelf's top border and hairline and the 1 by 60 pt line, over 5 pt of desktop. Nothing is masked; the crop lies between the two icons.

comparisons.name: rest-light
comparisons.description: Three tiles at rest on a flat grey desktop, Aqua: the shelf's material, the running dot, and no label.

pixels.note: the shelf below the tiles: --mac-material-dock, white at 0.27 over the grey desktop #808080 (measured, computed)
the running dot under the first tile, centred 4 pt above the bottom: --mac-dock-indicator (measured)
the desktop where the first tile's label appears under the pointer: no label at rest
the second tile's icon, centred 38 pt below the shelf's top
a child of the third tile, a 16 pt square: drawn over the tile from its top trailing corner, in front of the icon, which also covers this point
the third tile's icon just beyond the child: the child takes no room from it

comparisons.name: rest-dark
comparisons.description: Three tiles at rest on a flat grey desktop, Dark Aqua: the shelf's material and the running dot.

pixels.note: the shelf below the tiles: --mac-material-dock, grey 60 at 0.25 over the grey desktop #808080 (provisional token)
the running dot: --mac-dock-indicator, rgb(225 238 255) at 0.6 over the shelf (measured, computed)

comparisons.name: hover-light
comparisons.description: The pointer over the first tile, Aqua: its label appears above the shelf, and with reduced motion the magnification the Dock asks for moves nothing. The label is inferred; no screenshot shows one.

pixels.note: the label's padding: --mac-dock-label-background, grey 240 at 0.92 over the desktop (provisional)
the shelf above the tile: the tile has not grown, the comparison runs with prefers-reduced-motion

comparisons.name: hover-dark
comparisons.description: The pointer over the first tile, Dark Aqua: its label appears above the shelf. Inferred; no screenshot shows one.

pixels.note: the label's padding: --mac-dock-label-background, rgb(46 48 51) at 0.92 over the desktop (provisional)

comparisons.name: focus-light
comparisons.description: Keyboard focus on the first tile, reached with Tab, Aqua: the focus ring around the tile. Inferred; no screenshot shows the Dock with keyboard focus.

pixels.note: the 3 pt ring left of the tile: --mac-focus-ring-color, rgb(24 106 246) at 0.5 over the shelf #a2a2a2

comparisons.name: focus-dark
comparisons.description: Keyboard focus on the first tile, reached with Tab, Dark Aqua. Inferred; no screenshot shows the Dock with keyboard focus.

pixels.note: the 3 pt ring left of the tile: --mac-focus-ring-color, rgb(43 168 255) at 0.5 over the shelf #6f6f6f

comparisons.name: left-light
comparisons.description: The Dock on the left edge, Aqua: an 80 pt wide shelf centred on the edge, with the running dot between the tile and the edge. Inferred; no screenshot shows the Dock on a side.

pixels.note: the shelf between the tiles and its inner edge: --mac-material-dock over the grey desktop
the desktop beyond the shelf, which is 80 pt wide
the running dot, centred 4 pt from the screen edge beside the first tile: --mac-dock-indicator

comparisons.name: forced-colors-light
comparisons.description: Forced colours: the shelf keeps an edge. The colours are the browser's emulated system colours, not Catalina's.

pixels.note: the shelf's top border, 1 pt: CanvasText
the shelf: Canvas, with no backdrop filter
